_help: Only questions with confirmed answers belong here. answer uses the same simple formatting as news (blank line = paragraph, [text](url) = link, **bold**). group is used to cluster questions.

items.q: Which languages and directions are evaluated?
items.a: All 72 directions among Bengali, Bhojpuri, Chhattisgarhi, Hindi, Kannada, Magahi, Maithili, Marathi and Telugu, in both tasks. See [the challenge page](challenge.html#languages).

items.q: Are the source and target languages given to the system?
items.a: Yes. Source and target language IDs are provided.

items.q: What is the difference between the two tracks?
items.a: The **constrained track** allows only the challenge training set and a fixed list of public checkpoints announced at launch. The **open track** allows the challenge data plus any public corpora and any public model; proprietary APIs are allowed only if declared. See [tracks](challenge.html#tracks).

items.q: Can I use Whisper, SeamlessM4T or IndicTrans2 in the constrained track?
items.a: Only checkpoints on the fixed list are allowed in the constrained track. The list will be announced at launch.

items.q: Can I use a proprietary API, such as a commercial speech or language model?
items.a: Only in the open track, and only if its use is declared.

items.q: How many submissions can I make?
items.a: Submissions go to an evaluation server with a daily limit.

items.q: Do I need to describe my system?
items.a: Yes. Each team submits a system description.
items._NEED_THESE_DETAILS: Format, length and deadline of the system description.

items.a: Accepted challenge papers are presented in a dedicated session at [ASLI 2027](https://2027.ieeeasli.org/) in Singapore and published in IEEE Xplore as part of the ASLI 2027 Challenge & Demo Proceedings.

items.q: How long can a challenge paper be?
items.a: Up to three pages of technical content, plus one additional page for references. Challenge papers are reviewed single-blind, on a timeline separate from regular ASLI papers. Papers are due on 17 June 2027.

items.q: Will the data be available after the challenge?
items.a: Yes. The data, baselines and evaluation scripts will be released for research after the challenge.
